[Durbin PLC](https://durbinglobal.com/) (now operating as part of the Uniphar Group) is a global specialist medical and pharmaceutical supplier. It does not manufacture or develop consumer health tech like continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, sleep trackers, or remote patient monitoring platforms. [](https://durbinglobal.com/page/2/)

- **Core Business:** Sourcing and distributing pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, and clinical trial supplies globally.

- **Current Status:** Operates under the Product Access Division of Uniphar PLC. [](https://durbinglobal.com/page/2/)

### Common Wearable Health Technologies

If you are looking for specific remote health monitoring or tracking devices, the primary categories function as follows:

- **Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):** Sub-dermal sensors (such as Abbott Libre or Dexcom) that track interstitial glucose 24/7.

- **Smartwatches & Wearables:** Wrist-based
